verdict.rationale: Pulley's own docs cover reflecting vesting acceleration, stopping vesting at termination, and automatic email alerts when a holder reaches a new vesting event, which implies the platform tracks vesting schedules. Nothing in the evidence shows ops users defining custom schedules, cliffs or milestone-based vesting, or an explicit vested-vs-unvested view. missing for 10: documented custom vesting schedule builder, cliff configuration, milestone/performance-based vesting, explicit vested vs unvested tracking view, independent corroboration.
